bug_semantics: Authenticated path traversal and arbitrary file read in GET /download-export. routes/web.php places the endpoint inside the auth middleware group, but FileDownloadController::download_export() formed $path as export_path() . $_GET['filename']; file_exists() was the only gate before response()->download($path). A low-privilege authenticated caller could therefore supply ../ segments (for example, ../../.env relative to storage/app/rconfig/exports/) to escape the exports directory and download any file readable by the web-server process, exposing secrets such as application keys and database or mail credentials.
flaw_origin: Commit 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8 is the atomic first writer of the flawed sink: it created app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php with download_export(), the raw $_GET['filename'] concatenation, the file_exists() check, and response()->download(), and added export_path(). Its direct parent 09fa5a4eac1abb8ee5010bb85b39411f36a6fa5e has no FileDownloadController, no export_path() helper, and no download-export route; only DeviceInventoryExporter already emitted a link to that not-yet-routed endpoint. Commit 5eda5fcf38a87a1ceb39762474df6c2211def9fb later added the authenticated route and made the already-flawed sink remotely reachable, but it did not write or alter the vulnerable path construction, so it is lifecycle activation rather than the BIC.
ai_marker: Absent on BIC 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8. `git cat-file -p` shows author and committer danielrConfig <daniel@rconfig.com> and only the subject `feat: add file download functionality and export path helper`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI trailer, or bot identity in the BIC commit object.
evidence: Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qrrp-6pvj-xfvf identifies authenticated traversal through the filename GET parameter, cites d133a466a2df9d065177de9a8ed50f1bfe438aee, and says versions before 8.2.13 are affected. In the validated clone, `git log cc83dc07b9a011fcabb50cb916a91b393e8ad4f3 -L 21,23:app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` reaches only 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8 and shows the new function and `$path = export_path() . $_GET['filename'];`; `git log --all -S"$_GET['filename']" -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` reports introduction at 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8 and removal at d133a466a2df9d065177de9a8ed50f1bfe438aee. `git blame --line-porcelain -L 21,23 cc83dc07b9a011fcabb50cb916a91b393e8ad4f3 -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` attributes the vulnerable method and path expression to 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8. `git show 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8` shows that commit creating the controller and export_path(); `git grep -n 'download_export\|download-export\|export_path' 09fa5a4eac1abb8ee5010bb85b39411f36a6fa5e` finds none of those definitions or routes, directly verifying parent absence. `git show 5eda5fcf38a87a1ceb39762474df6c2211def9fb -- routes/web.php` shows the later GET route added inside Route::group(['middleware' => 'auth']). `git show d133a466a2df9d065177de9a8ed50f1bfe438aee -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` shows the direct fix replacing raw global input with Request query input reduced by basename(), rejecting empty names, and requiring the real path to be an is_file() physically beneath the real export root before download; PR https://github.com/rconfig/rconfig/pull/349 describes the same traversal and symlink containment. `git grep -n 'export_path() .*filename\|isContainedInExportPath\|basename((string)' core-8.2.12 core-8.2.13 -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` shows the raw concatenation at core-8.2.12 and basename plus containment at core-8.2.13. `git tag --contains d133a466a2df9d065177de9a8ed50f1bfe438aee --list 'core-*' --sort=version:refname` starts at core-8.2.13, while the BIC and route are contained from core-8.0.0 onward. Annotated core-8.2.12 peels to 28b88100001c277f30a46ef8f512af2e0f59928b; core-8.2.13 peels to release commit 72b60a41d9589f3b2e0c5ea0062734b6a0b5a86d, whose composer.json/config/app.php diff sets 8.2.13 and whose changelog records the export containment. Thus the tagged vulnerable range evidenced by history is core-8.0.0 through core-8.2.12, and core-8.2.13 is the first fixed tag. Finally, `git cat-file -p 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8` reproduces the BIC-only marker check and contains no AI signal.
reasoning: The root cause is the controller's first-written trust-boundary failure, not the later route, later formatting/import changes, or the security fix. Both -L and -S converge on the one-parent atomic commit 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8, and its direct parent lacks the flawed sink, so no squash decomposition is applicable. The route commit 5eda5fcf38a87a1ceb39762474df6c2211def9fb completes exploitability under authentication, and the code remains materially unchanged through core-8.2.12. Direct fix d133a466a2df9d065177de9a8ed50f1bfe438aee closes both lexical traversal and symlink escape before core-8.2.13; later 25d6d2f4314f3c38186d98df9c11da8fe0222862 centralizes the already-present containment and is not required to close this flaw. AI attribution is judged solely from the BIC commit object: it has a human author/committer and no AI marker. The Claude co-author trailer on the later fix and any PR-body generation disclosure are explicitly irrelevant to BIC attribution. Therefore the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
